description: This file implements a routing strategy for selecting the lowest latency deployment of a model, including classes for handling routing arguments and logging latency metrics, with methods for both synchronous and asynchronous retrieval of deployment options based on latency and usage statistics.

classes.name: RoutingArgs
classes.description: A Pydantic model class for configuring routing parameters such as TTL, latency buffer, and maximum latency list size.

classes.name: LowestLatencyLoggingHandler
classes.description: A custom logger class that records latency metrics and manages deployment selection based on response time and usage statistics.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful response event, updating latency and token usage metrics in cache.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event, specifically handling timeout errors by penalizing latency.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful response event, updating latency and token usage metrics in cache.

methods.name: _get_available_deployments
methods.description: Determines the best deployment based on latency and usage, for both sync and async contexts.

methods.name: async_get_available_deployments
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves deployment options based on latency and usage.

methods.name: get_available_deployments
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves deployment options based on latency and usage.
